The '''''Shrike''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] manufactured by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]]. It was in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dren Jamer]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
